base.note: v1.5.9 is a focused simulator UI patch over the deployed v1.5.8 baseline.

changes.UNIVERSAL_EXAM_PAPER_159: All exam sessions launch/resume in the paper booklet + separate answer sheet layout; historical exams retain original numbering and custom/2026 exams use session numbering.
changes.SCRATCH_CANDIDATE_159: Paper options support independent candidate marks stored as scratch state candidate; multiple candidates are allowed and candidate does not imply question doubt.
changes.REVERSIBLE_CROSSOUT_159: Crossout uses an explicit × toggle; clicking × again clears it, and clicking a crossed option also restores it.
changes.ANSWER_SHEET_SOURCE_MAPPING_159: Custom exams preserve shuffled alternatives by mapping displayed answer-sheet letters to canonical source letters; historical exams remain unshuffled.
changes.CUSTOM_BREAK_PAPER_159: Flexible custom-exam breaks remain reachable from paper mode; official two-part A/B isolation remains unchanged.
changes.SEMANTICS_PRESERVED_159: No changes to scheduler, memory algorithm, Supabase schema, dataset, taxonomy, PT409/recovery or protected session files.
changes.QUESTION_DOUBT_PERSISTENCE_159: Question-level ? doubt is persisted through a SessionCore-compatible scratch encoding, remaining independent from tentative candidate marks.
